summary: Reads positional, skeletal, interaction, and optional face-tracking data from Kinect for Windows and Kinect 2 sensors.
key_concepts: Reads positional and skeletal tracking data from Kinect for Windows or Kinect 2 hardware, with full/seated/off skeleton modes.
Kinect v1 can track up to two full skeletons while Kinect 2 can track up to six; additional center positions may still be tracked.
World Space, Color Space, Depth Space, face tracking, and interaction toggles choose which coordinate and interaction channels are emitted.
Bone rotation and length options support rigging workflows, and Unroll Bone Values avoids wraparound discontinuities before blending or filtering.
Joint smoothing, prediction, jitter radius, max deviation, and rotation smoothing trade raw responsiveness against noise and latency.

common_gotchas: Official docs list this operator as Windows-only.
Only Kinect for Windows hardware and Kinect 2 are supported, not Kinect for Xbox hardware.
Kinect 2 requires the Kinect 2 SDK/runtime; Kinect v1 requires the Kinect runtime matching the TouchDesigner build era.
The Kinect 2 SDK does not allow multiple Kinect 2 devices on one system at the same time.
Interaction mode requires a 640x480 depth resolution and can affect the matching Kinect TOP depth output.
Unroll bone rotation values before blending/filtering skeletal rotations to avoid wraparound jumps.
